stem.en: Kabir attacks. Pick his best card.

text.en: "Same equation, same energy. A short circuit and a motor are the same chemistry. You have not found a difference in the reaction, only in the wiring, and you cannot see the wiring."
"The peanut burned in a minute and Kabir took a day, so the seed's reaction is different."

feedback.en: The hump lesson showed the same reaction runs at any speed if the hump is lowered. Speed is not the reaction.

text.en: "The flame made light and Kabir did not, so light is the difference."

feedback.en: Light is one way for a fall to come out, along with heat. A hot wire glows; a warm one does not. Same fall.

image.alt: A boy playing his best card in a duel over a notebook page showing the flame-and-seed reaction ledger, a peanut and a small battery on the table.
